commit 181b3346eedbb56a93f8ace5770738a45571605b
Author: RJ <rj@localhost>
Date:   Mon Nov 9 01:50:18 2026 +0100

    fix(codex-agent): per-round usage on resume; tool budgets for discuss rounds
    
    - parse-output: `codex exec resume` reports THREAD-cumulative usage in
      turn.completed (0.167.0: two identical resumed rounds reported 51,968
      then 88,026 input tokens; each round's own share was ~35K), so the usage
      ledger re-counted every earlier round. parseCodexOutput takes an optional
      previousTotals and returns usage (this round), threadTotals (to pass to
      the next resumed round) and usageMode (run | delta | raw-fallback). Also
      reports cached_input_tokens. Old 2-argument calls behave as before.
      Verified on saved 0.167 JSONL: resumed rounds now yield 34,828 / 36,058 /
      356,634 input tokens.
    - discuss: carry threadTotals between rounds and pass them when parsing
      resumed rounds (6a, 10b); fresh threads (round 1, 6b, 10c) pass ''.
    - discuss: "facts first" guidance, and prompt tool budgets of 8 calls in
      round 1 and 3 in follow-up rounds (none for execution). Measured: an
      open-ended round 1 took ~33 steps / 113,659 uncached tokens; a follow-up
      asked for <=3 tools used 4 and added 2,586 uncached. Web tools stay on
      until the lean-profile plugin set is decided: -c web_search="disabled"
      alone does not stop browsing via plugin tools.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
    Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01KPDbM3HLm4iyDRG27o7uYy

+var USAGE_FIELDS = ["inputTokens", "cachedInputTokens", "outputTokens", "totalTokens", "estimatedCost"];
+
+function copyUsage(u) {
+  var out = {};
+  for (var i = 0; i < USAGE_FIELDS.length; i++) out[USAGE_FIELDS[i]] = Number(u[USAGE_FIELDS[i]]) || 0;
+  return out;
+}
+
+/**
+ * current - previous, field by field. Returns null if input or output tokens would go
+ * negative, which means the reported numbers were not cumulative after all.
+ */
+function subtractUsage(current, previous) {
+  var prev = copyUsage(previous || {});
+  var out = {};
+  for (var i = 0; i < USAGE_FIELDS.length; i++) {
+    var f = USAGE_FIELDS[i];
+    out[f] = current[f] - prev[f];
+  }
+  if (out.inputTokens < 0 || out.outputTokens < 0) return null;
+  return out;
+}
